kpis.description_fr: Consumer Products = jouets traditionnels (Nerf, Play-Doh, Monopoly, Transformers). Décrue séculaire vs digital. Pression retail.
kpis.description_en: Consumer Products = traditional toys (Nerf, Play-Doh, Monopoly, Transformers). Secular decline vs digital. Retail pressure.

kpis.short: Wizards of the Coast & Digital Gaming
kpis.description_fr: Wizards = Magic The Gathering + D&D + Baldur's Gate 3 (Larian). Plus rentable segment Hasbro (~40 % EBIT). Croissance forte MTG.
kpis.description_en: Wizards = Magic The Gathering + D&D + Baldur's Gate 3 (Larian). Hasbro's most profitable segment (~40% EBIT). Strong MTG growth.

kpis.description_fr: Entertainment = ce qui reste post-cession eOne (Lionsgate, 2023). Slimmé. Focus IP licensing toys.
kpis.description_en: Entertainment = remaining post eOne divestiture (to Lionsgate 2023). Slimmed. Focus on IP licensing for toys.

kpis.description_fr: Magic The Gathering = #1 trading card game monde. Premier produit Hasbro >1 Md $ CA. Modèle live ops + sets sortie réguliers.
kpis.description_en: Magic The Gathering = world's #1 trading card game. First Hasbro product >$1B revenue. Live ops + regular set release model.

kpis.description_fr: OCF en récup post-transition. Cession eOne 2023 nettoie bilan. Capex léger. Permet dividende ~$2.80/share + désendettement.
kpis.description_en: OCF recovering post-transition. eOne divestiture 2023 cleans balance sheet. Light capex. Enables ~$2.80/share dividend + deleveraging.
